svg.title: Work-tracker seam and its first adapter
svg.desc: The factory reaches a work tracker only through the provider-neutral trait; the ready rule and finish sequence sit on the seam, the fake double and the GitHub adapter sit behind it.

g.text: FACTORY (OSF CRATE) · CONSUMERS OF THE SEAM
